title: GET /v1/version
description: Implemented in launcher 0.1.15. api_version is the /v1 contract version; version is the build the launcher is running (git describe based, so a build off a tag carries a local segment and can never claim the tag); release is the release the source sits on; build carries the describe output and commit; capabilities lists what this host supports.

version.description: Build the launcher runs: `<release>` only for a clean checkout exactly at the tag, else `<release>+<commits>.g<sha>[.dirty]`, `<release>+g<sha>` when only a SHA is known, or `<release>+unknown` when no build identity exists.

release.description: Release the source sits on (pyproject.toml), for example 0.1.15.

build.description: Build identity: where the version came from (git metadata, a baked hyvv-build.json, the apply-update receipt, or nothing) and the commit it names.

capabilities.description: Known v1 capabilities. Implementations must advertise every capability they support.
